Upload a sealed audit folder to the audit registry, without GitHub. The folder is verified here first, packed as one .tar.gz under its own name, sent straight to the registry's storage, and submitted; the registry then runs verify on it again and lists it under your name.

The registry's address comes from --registry or CODEFLOWER_AUDIT_REGISTRY, and an API token (made in the registry's Settings) from CODEFLOWER_REGISTRY_TOKEN.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower audit submit FOLDER [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--registry string` |  | the registry's address (default $CODEFLOWER_AUDIT_REGISTRY) |
